Name: Epaenetus
Summary: Epaenetus was Paul's wellbeloved friend and the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ, greeted among the Roman Christians in Romans 16.
KeyStory: Epaenetus was Paul's wellbeloved friend and the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ, greeted among the Roman Christians in Romans 16.
LifeLesson: The first to believe in a place carry a special joy; their faith opens the way for others.
